_doc: Stage-3 skinning inputs for Brax (tools/blender/gf_hero/s3_skin.py). Metres, Blender axes (Z up, faces -Y, +X = his left). Hand-edited; rerun python tools/blender/gf_hero/run_stage3.py brax after a change.

body._doc: BODY = the fitted MakeHuman hm08 mesh. seed = MakeHuman CC0 game_engine weights (exact per vertex, s3_mh_seed.py). heat_mix blends Blender's bone-heat automatic weights into the seed per region (0 = seed only); heat also fills any vertex the seed leaves empty.

heat_mix._doc: 0 = MakeHuman seed only, 1 = bone heat only. Torso and limbs take half of each (heat smooths the seed's sharp shoulder and hip borders); the hands keep the seed (heat is unreliable on fingers); the head keeps most of the seed (face loops).

twist._doc: share of a limb class moved onto its twist bone along the bone (t = 0 at the bone head, 1 at the tail): upper arm and thigh fade out from the head over [0, fade_end]; the forearm fades in over [fade_start, 1].

body._doc_fixes: Hand-style fixes. rest_relax runs first (positions only, before any weight). Then, after the seed/heat mix and the twist split: joint_blend (a blend band across a joint plane), smooth (Laplacian over the edge graph), spatial_smooth (a Euclidean Gaussian, so folds like the jaw over the throat and the armpit move together). A region is the vertices within radius of the named bone's segment, faded over its outer 30 %.
body._doc_joint_blend: joint_blend: the pair (parent class, child class) is re-split by a smoothstep across the joint plane (the child bone's head, along the child bone), half_width either side, shifted by offset (+ = toward the child) and, on the outside of the bend (outer_dir, rest-pose world direction), by offset_outer: the knee cap stays with the thigh and the olecranon with the forearm, as on a hand-painted rig.

rest_relax.name: extra_loops_onto_the_profile
rest_relax._doc: the stage-2 knee / elbow / wrist loops were inserted at edge midpoints after the fit (chords inside the curved profile: groove rings); each loop vertex moves onto the 4-point subdivision curve of its longitudinal edge loop

parts._doc: Separate closed meshes. head: 100 % head. copy: the body's weights at the closest body point (tight wraps, belt band). rigid: one weight row for the whole connected piece (mean of its copied or hanging weights). hang: skirt-style cloth: the top copies the body, lower down it hangs from the pelvis and follows the thigh on its side (both thighs at the centre line) by up to follow_max at the knee.
